title: Security Assessment Report: Public Demonstration
author: NoScope (L.G Sithum Sanjana)
executive_summary: This public demo uses fictionalized findings to demonstrate how a security assessment can communicate risk, impact and remediation without exposing client information or real engagement evidence.
executive_summary_si: මෙය client තොරතුරු හෝ සත්‍ය engagement evidence හෙළි නොකර security assessment report එකක risk, impact සහ remediation පෙන්වන fictional public demonstration එකකි.
methodology: OWASP Testing Guide, PTES, NIST SP 800-115

findings.title: Broken Object-Level Authorization in a Demo API
findings.description: A fictional API example does not consistently verify whether the authenticated user owns the requested object.
findings.impact: An unauthorized user could view or modify another test user's demo resource.
findings.remediation: Enforce server-side authorization for every object read and mutation, scoped by the authenticated user and tenant.

findings.title: Insufficient Security Event Context
findings.description: The fictional service records failed requests without enough principal, object and correlation context for reliable investigation.
findings.impact: Suspicious access patterns may be difficult to investigate or correlate.
findings.remediation: Log authenticated principal, object, action, policy decision and correlation ID while protecting sensitive values.

findings.title: Missing Defensive Response Headers
findings.description: The fictional web service does not consistently return baseline browser security headers.
findings.impact: Browser-side protections are weaker than necessary for a production deployment.
findings.remediation: Define and test a suitable Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security and X-Content-Type-Options policy.
